h1: Destino Hotel Surin — a clean new hotel right next to Robinson in Surin
intro: If you're in Surin and want a new hotel with clean rooms, a fair price and a mall on your doorstep — Destino Hotel Surin is a small 3-star boutique hotel of around 20 rooms, set right beside Robinson Lifestyle Surin on Surin-Sikhoraphum Road. The rooms are modern with comfy beds, some have a private balcony looking onto the garden, and breakfast, parking and Wi-Fi are all free. From approx. THB 1,300/night. Scored 8.8 from 11 reviews on Trip.com, and ranked #9 of 19 specialty lodgings in Surin on TripAdvisor.

body.html: What gets Destino talked about in Surin is how new it is. It's a recently opened hotel where everything still looks clean and modern — a rare thing in a town where most stays have a fair few years on them. Reviews agree the rooms are very clean, the beds comfortable, and the property genuinely feels brand new. As a small boutique hotel of around 20 rooms, it's also quieter and more private than the bigger hotels in town.

There are several room types, from a Superior and Deluxe Twin to a Deluxe Triple and a Family Room with a balcony. Every room is modern, with a free minibar and a flat-screen TV, and some have a private balcony looking onto the garden. Many guests say the rooms are larger than expected at this price and well equipped. Because it's a new build, the bathrooms and furniture are still in good shape rather than worn, unlike many older stays in town.
"Spotlessly clean room, comfortable bed, the friendliest staff ever, and breakfast all cooked fresh. Robinson is right next door — you can just walk over."

Breakfast is another point that comes up often in reviews. It runs roughly 7:00–10:00 and is cooked fresh to order, with a reasonable choice — guests say it tastes good and is freshly made rather than a buffet left sitting out. Being a small hotel, the morning has an easy, home-style feel rather than that of a big property. Breakfast is included with the room, which guests like since there's nothing extra to pay.

The facilities cover what you'd want from a city hotel. There's a garden, a terrace, a restaurant, free parking and free Wi-Fi in every room. The free parking is a hit with self-drivers, and front-desk staff earn consistent praise across platforms for being friendly and helpful. Sitting right next to Robinson means food and shopping are a short walk away — no need to drive out.

The hotel is at 444 Village No. 16, Surin-Sikhoraphum Road, Salakdai — right beside Robinson Lifestyle Surin. It's a few minutes' walk to Robinson, near the Thep Thani intersection and Wat Khok In. The railway station is about 5 km away, and the old-town centre with the Phraya Surin Monument is roughly 5–10 minutes by car. The upside is easy mall access and simple in-and-out by car, though some reviews note the hotel sits on a busy main road, so you may hear traffic in some rooms. Scored 8.8 from 11 reviews on Trip.com and ranked #9 of 19 specialty lodgings in Surin on TripAdvisor.

To be straight about it, Destino Hotel Surin suits anyone after a fresh, clean room at an affordable price who likes staying next to a mall — whether you're here to work, to sightsee, or just passing through Surin and want one comfortable night. But if you're expecting resort-level facilities like a pool or a spa, this isn't that; it's a small hotel focused on clean rooms. One more thing worth knowing: the review count is still modest because it's a new hotel, and the property sits on a busy road — so if you're sensitive to noise, ask for an inner room.

A tip from following the reviews here: if you sleep light, ask for a room away from the main road when booking to dodge the traffic noise. If you want a more open feel, ask for one of the rooms with a balcony over the garden. And the hotel's free parking is handy for self-drivers — just flag it at check-in.

faqTitle: Frequently asked questions — Destino Hotel Surin

faq.q: Where is Destino Hotel Surin, and what's nearby?
faq.a: The hotel is at 444 Village No. 16, Surin-Sikhoraphum Road, Salakdai — right next to Robinson Lifestyle Surin. It's a few minutes' walk to Robinson, near the Thep Thani intersection and Wat Khok In. The railway station is about 5 km away, and the Phraya Surin Monument is roughly 5–10 minutes by car.

faq.q: How much does Destino Hotel Surin cost, and what rooms are there?
faq.a: Prices start from approx. THB 1,300/night for a Superior Room. There's also a Deluxe Twin, a Deluxe Triple and a Family Room with Balcony overlooking the garden. Rates vary by season and package, so compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Is Destino Hotel Surin really new, and are the rooms clean?
faq.a: Yes — it's a recently opened small hotel of around 20 rooms. Most reviews praise it as very clean, with everything still looking new and modern, comfy beds and well-equipped rooms — a real advantage in a town where most stays are a fair bit older.

faq.q: Who is Destino Hotel Surin best for?
faq.a: It's a strong fit for travellers who want a fresh, clean room at an affordable price and like staying next to a mall — for work, sightseeing or a one-night stopover. The free parking suits self-drivers. If you need a pool or a resort-style spa, an out-of-town stay may suit you better.

faq.q: What's breakfast like at Destino Hotel Surin?
faq.a: Breakfast earns praise in reviews — cooked fresh to order, served roughly 7:00–10:00, and tasty rather than a buffet left sitting out. It's a small, home-style affair, and it's included with the room, so there's nothing extra to pay.

faq.q: Does Destino Hotel Surin have parking, and is it noisy?
faq.a: Yes — there's free parking, handy for self-drivers. Worth knowing: the hotel sits on a fairly busy main road, so some rooms hear traffic. If you're sensitive to noise, ask for an inner room away from the road when booking.
